indicator_name: NBK macroeconomic survey of analysts: median forecasts by round
description: Макроэкономический опрос НБК (аналитики): медианы прогнозов по раундам
unit: as named in item_name (%, USD per barrel, bn USD, KZT per USD)
methodology: Rounds from 2022-08 (8-10 a year, 12-15 respondents), dated by round. Item VARIABLE.YEAR = median forecast for that calendar year: CPI_DEC (Dec/Dec inflation), GDP (real growth), BASE_RATE (annual average), BRENT, USDKZT (annual average), EXPORTS / IMPORTS (goods and services, bn USD); NEUTRAL_RATE, LR_GDP (potential growth, 5-year horizon), CPI_5Y without a year. Irregular rounds: gaps between dates are not missing data.
